aggregate: unweighted mean AP of the three registered folds
sampling: One CERT-universe multinomial draw shared across all families and all folds; all observations of one CERT receive same multiplicity
interval: marginal unadjusted percentile 2.5/97.5; exclude entire replicate if any fold has zero weighted positives
scope: Conditional on selected archived candidates and fixed OOF predictions; not selection-adjusted, not historical CI recovery, no temporal block bootstrap or training/test inference
